title: Listening Drill — Making a paper model — Trial review
description: Conversation about a trial. One synthetic recording, six questions. Recommended time: 7 minutes.

sections.title: Making a paper model — Trial review
sections.transcript:
HOST: You ran two introductory sessions on making a paper model last week. What happened in the first one?

GUEST: On the first run, several people reported a problem with loose joins. At first we wondered whether it was a problem with the instructions. A closer inspection revealed the fault: blunt blade.

HOST: What changed when you ran the session again?

GUEST: On each trial, we now keep a record of fold position so changes can be compared. For the second trial we let everyone borrow card sheets instead of bringing their own. That helped us keep the equipment as consistent as possible.

HOST: What should people who attended do now?

GUEST: Send any suggestions directly to the model tutor before the next group arrives. The next group comes on Friday, so we have time to compare notes beforehand.
